routingDesc: Automatic agent switching is locked. The dispatcher checks this policy and quotas before each task.
uiScaleDesc: Scales root font size (rem). Shortcuts: Cmd/Ctrl + enlarge, Cmd/Ctrl − shrink, Cmd/Ctrl 0 → 100%.
alertSoundDesc: Repeating audio while an approval is pending. Volume and interval stay as configured when the window is in the background.
alertSoundBackgroundNote: When the window is in the background, volume and repeat interval are not escalated; an OS notification is sent additionally.
editorDesc: Used for Open in editor on dead symbols and indexed files. Custom templates use a {path} placeholder validated in Rust (no shell).
editorDesktopOnly: Editor test requires the desktop app
autoArchiveDesc: Unused experiences are archived after the TTL. Use-count threshold limits archiving to low-usage rows when set (>0).
useCountThresholdHint: When >0, only archive rows with use_count ≤ threshold after TTL.
destructiveDesc: These patterns always require explicit confirmation. Never Ask cannot bypass them.
destructiveNeverAsk: Always confirm — Never Ask cannot skip destructive operations (agent and user initiated).
graphUiDesc: Lounge Graph UI uses port band {{start}}–{{end}} (not Antigravity’s 9749). Auto picks the first free port; User keeps a fixed port. Desktop agents must read the live port from status — never assume 9749.
graphUiLifecycle: Enable starts Graph UI on an owned Lounge port. Open focuses the Graph window. Closing Lounge stops only the process Lounge started. Foreign codebase-memory-mcp instances are never adopted.
graphModeSavedAuto: Auto mode saved — first free port in {{start}}–{{end}}.
graphModeSavedUser: User mode saved — fixed port {{port}} (no auto-switch on conflict).
graphOwnershipOwned: Ownership: Lounge child owns this port
graphOwnershipForeign: Ownership: not owned by Lounge (HTTP /rpc disabled)
graphOwnershipUnknown: Ownership: unknown (desktop probe unavailable in browser).
graphPortSaved: Graph UI user port saved: {{port}}. Open Graph windows recreate on the new port.
graphStateUnknown: Status: unknown (desktop probe unavailable in browser).
graphStateDisabled: Status: disabled · will use port {{port}} when enabled
graphStateConflict: Status: port {{port}} conflict — foreign listener; Auto will skip, User will not switch
graphAutoPortInfo: {{busy}} is in use by another process; {{next}} will be used
diagnosticsDesc: Kernel and supervisor logs are written under the app data directory so empty redirected stdout still leaves a diagnosable file.
diagnosticsBrowser: Log paths are available in the desktop app (Tauri).
